status.en: 11 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 31% fewer than the week before, most of them in Tigray, Amhara and Merti.
status.nb: 11 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 31 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Tigray, Amhara og Merti.

summary.en: Ethiopian drones are now operating over Sudan while RSF drones launch from Ethiopian territory against Sudanese targets, prompting reciprocal diplomatic expulsions and consular closures. An RPG strike near a school in Moyale killed dozens of Ethiopian Orthodox believers and a Kenyan, and attacks on Orthodox Christians continue in Arsi, Benishangul Gumuz and the north, with blasts heard in Addis Ababa. Seed insecurity is threatening Tigray farmers and a psychosocial and spiritual care pilot is being tested. The conflict has displaced more than 50,000 people and caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Etiopiske droner opererer nå over Sudan mens RSF-militsen lanserer droner fra etiopisk territorium mot sudanske mål, noe som har ført til gjensidige diplomatiske utvisninger og konsulære nedleggelser. Et RPG-angrep nær en skole i Moyale drepte dusinvis av etiopiske ortodokse troende og en kenyaner, og angrep på ortodokse kristne fortsetter i Arsi, Benishangul Gumuz og i nord, med eksplosjoner hørt i Addis Ababa. Sikkerhetsproblemer for frø truer bønder i Tigray, og et pilotprosjekt for psykososial og åndelig omsorg blir testet. Konflikten har fordrevet mer enn 50 000 personer og forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano Insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
